title: Protective safeguards endorsement evidence for commercial property renewal
scope: Original summaries of a policy specimen, one historical court opinion, New York City’s Fire Code and Fannie Mae multifamily documentation. All underwriting inputs below are fictional and identify no live property.

locators: Pages 6–8, endorsement conditions and insurer notice

document_observations.scope: The scheduled premises and building numbers identify where a safeguard applies. The form specifies maintenance, activation and notice conditions.
document_observations.notice_exception_scope: The exception addresses the insurer notice requirement for specified partial shutoffs when full protection can be restored within the period. Review the issued form and local requirements separately.

document_observations.observation: The court treated the notice exception in the policy before it as separate from maintenance and granted summary judgment for the insurer on the fire claim.
The local provisions separately address planned work, agency notification and evidence of restoration. The notice triggers include sprinkler protection out of service on more than one floor.
The program distinguishes temporary from permanent evidence and lists an individual endorsement and an insurance binder among items insufficient as permanent evidence by themselves.

input.file_evidence: Building 01 has a signed-off sprinkler permit. Owner provided no current inspection or protection schedule for Building 02.

request: Match the policy schedule, statement of values and building identifier.
Obtain scope and current inspection, testing and maintenance records for Building 02.

input.file_evidence: The owner reports proposed sprinkler work affecting more than one floor. The file has an issued permit and no restoration test report because work has yet to occur.

request: Obtain the actual policy schedule and confirm notice requirements with the broker and carrier.
Ask the impairment coordinator for the applicable notification and restoration records as they become available.

input.file_evidence: A binder and a single protective safeguards endorsement appear in the file. The full policy or other qualifying permanent evidence has not been provided.

request: Check the loan program and evidence deadline.
Obtain permanent evidence accepted under the applicable program and keep the active safeguard schedule with the policy review.
